faq.domanda: What are the advantages of vehicle wrapping compared to other forms of advertising?
faq.risposta: Vehicle wrapping is advertising on the move, visible 24/7, and it offers a very low cost per view compared to other forms of marketing.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to wrap a vehicle in Ticino?
faq.risposta: Costs vary depending on the size of the vehicle, the type of wrap (partial or full) and the materials used. Contact us for a personalised quote.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to wrap a vehicle?
faq.risposta: The time required can range from 1 to 6 working days, depending on the complexity of the project and the surface to be wrapped.

faq.domanda: Is it possible to wrap only part of the vehicle, such as the doors or the bonnet?
faq.risposta: Absolutely. We offer both partial and full wraps, depending on your needs and the visual impact you want to achieve.

faq.domanda: Can I see a preview of the wrap?
faq.risposta: Yes. Before printing we send you a graphic draft of the project for approval, usually available once a deposit has been paid.

faq.domanda: Does the vehicle need to be washed before the wrap is applied?
faq.risposta: Yes. The vehicle must be clean and free of waxes or substances that could compromise the adhesion of the films. Otherwise, cleaning will be charged.

faq.domanda: What types of vehicles can be wrapped?
faq.risposta: We can wrap any type of vehicle, from company vans to private cars, right through to trucks and buses.
